title: Rollout-Time Intervention: Unlocking Agentic Reinforcement Learning Beyond Policy Limits
abstract: arXiv:2610.13438v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) has emerged as a key paradigm for improving large language model (LLM) agents, enabling stronger reasoning, planning, and tool-use in interactive environments. However, existing agent RL methods remain fundamentally constrained by an on-policy reasoning bottleneck: when tasks exceed the model's current capability boundary, effective trajectories become extremely sparse and training often collapses. We introduce Rollout-Time Intervention (RTI), a technique designed to elicit successful trajectories beyond the policy's intrinsic exploration capacity. RTI operates by leveraging reward-side evidence (i.e., evaluation rubrics) during rollout to convert erroneous trajectories into successful ones, providing effective learning signals for tasks that the policy rarely solves on its own. translated_title: 展开时干预：解锁超越策略极限的智能体强化学习
translated_abstract: 强化学习（RL）已成为提升大语言模型（LLM）智能体能力的关键范式，使其在交互环境中具备更强的推理、规划和工具使用能力。然而，现有的智能体强化学习方法从根本上受到同策略推理瓶颈的制约：当任务超出模型当前的能力边界时，有效轨迹变得极其稀疏，训练常常发生崩溃。我们提出了展开时干预，这是一种旨在诱导产生超出策略内在探索能力的成功轨迹的技术。RTI 通过在展开（rollout）过程中利用奖励侧证据（即评估量规），将错误轨迹转化为成功轨迹，为策略自身很少能独立解决的任务提供有效的学习信号。尽管干预产生的轨迹本质上是偏离策略的，但我们发现当轨迹（原文摘要在此处被截断）……
tldr: 提出展开时干预（RTI）技术，在轨迹采样阶段利用奖励侧证据（评估量规）将错误轨迹转化为成功轨迹，为超出模型能力边界的任务提供有效学习信号，突破智能体强化学习的同策略推理瓶颈。
en_tdlr: Proposes Rollout-Time Intervention (RTI), which leverages reward-side evidence during rollout to convert erroneous trajectories into successful ones, providing effective learning signals for tasks beyond the policy's capability boundary and unlocking agentic RL beyond policy limits.
